verses.text: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winhaj Merodac-baladán, sreyal Babilonia, yuninal winhaj Baladán, ix yab' winh yalji to pena'ayaxnak winhaj Ezequías chi', palta b'oxnakxi sk'ol winh. Yuj chi' ix schekkot juntzanh heb' schekab' winh yik tzul yak'ankan heb' tas ix tz'ib'ejkot winh rey chi' yet' silab'.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Ezequías chi' yujto ix jawi heb'. Ix sch'oxan masanil sb'eyumal winh t'a heb', haton k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro, perfume, aceite te wach', b'aj molan masanil yamk'ab' yik owal yet' masanil tastak ay t'a yet'tal b'aj molb'ab'il. Manhxa junok tas ay t'a spalacio winh yet' masanil tas ay t'a yol smakb'en winh maj sch'ox t'a heb' winh.

Haxo yik ix paxkan heb' winh, ix in b'at a in Isaías in tik schekab' Dios wil winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix in k'anb'an icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ix kot juntzanh heb' winh winak chi'? ¿Tas ix ul yal heb' winh t'ayach? xin chi. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha t'a jun chonhab' te najat ix kot heb' winh, haton Babilonia, xchi winh.

Ix in k'anb'anxi t'a winh: --¿Tas ix ul yil heb' winh t'a a palacio tik? xin chi. Ix yalan winh t'ayin: --Masanil tas ay t'a in palacio tik ix yil heb' winh, ix in ch'oxan masanil tastak molb'ab'il wu'uj, xchi winh.
Ix walan t'a winh icha tik: --Ab' wal tas syal Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil:
Ol k'och sk'uhal, masanil tas ay t'a a palacio tik yet' jantak tas ix smolb'ejkan heb' a mam icham yet' iko', ol ik'chajb'at masanil t'a Babilonia chi'.
Hanhejtona' heb' inhtilal, ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ol ik'chajel snholob' sk'e'en heb', ol ochkan heb' yak'umalok serwil winh rey chi' t'a spalacio, xin chi.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha jun lolonel ix schek Jehová al tik t'ayin, te wach' yaji, xchi winh. Yujto ix sna winh icha tik: Yakb'an pitzan in to, junk'olal kaji, malaj tas ol in ik'anok, xchi winh.
